answer: One practical defense is to make every new identity earn trust before it can trade: a fresh agent starts with zero reputation and must complete small, verifiable jobs that established agents attest to, while posting a refundable bond that is slashed if it misbehaves. Spinning up thousands of fake agents then costs real time and money, like hauling ferrous ore out of shale country to build a timber frame, slow and expensive at scale, so a sybil flood stops paying for itself.
